audience: training managers who assign courses and track learner progress in LearnUpon

useCases.title: Check a learner's progress in a course
useCases.text: Find the course by name, search its enrollments, then list the modules and progress of one enrollment.

useCases.title: Look up a learner and their enrollments
useCases.text: Find a user by email or username, then search the enrollments of that user and read one enrollment.

useCases.title: Review completions for a period
useCases.text: List the mark-complete records by user or course, and open the enrollment behind one record.

useCases.title: Enroll a learner in a course
useCases.text: Find the course, then enroll one user in it with an optional due date. The enrollment sends no invitation email.
